censusCoverage.note: _computed-styles.json measured 23 pages (21 page×width failures: browser context closed); _computed-styles-2.json re-measured 11 pages (tv-internet, televisie, ziggo-sport, ziggo-go and the 7 channel pages). Both merged: 33 pages, 66 page×width measurements. Aggregates (colors, radii, shadows, families, heading levels) are summed across both files.

notes: Palette capped at 8 first-party colors; dropped: #a9aeb2 (852, --color_gray-400), #d9dbde (848, --color_gray-200 / --color_surface-high), #4a4f54 (663, --color_gray-800), #01125d (510, --color_tertiary-darken-40), #757e84 (308, --color_gray-600), #60676c (224, --color_gray-700).

#f1f2f3 (surface, weight 770, bgArea 91921904) kept over #a9aeb2 (weight 852, bgArea 1686024) for the 8th slot: the spec weights occurrences by element area and #f1f2f3 is the dominant light section ground.

Excluded third-party/non-brand colors: #ff0000, #0000000d, #0177b5, #3c5ba2, #e03d19, #65bc54 (#ff0000 = Dimelo chat required-field asterisk; #0177b5/#3c5ba2/#e03d19/#65bc54 = LinkedIn/Facebook/Email/WhatsApp share-button fills on the channel pages (.social); #0000000d = table stripe).

Role naming: census heuristic assigns "primary" to the dominant button fill #001489 (Ziggo blue, CSS token --color_tertiary). The brand orange #ff5f00 is the CSS token --color_primary and dominates by area (24.6M px² bg area) but appears on buttons mainly via the third-party feedback tab; it is recorded here as role "secondary" (brand/hero color).
Design tokens are declared on body.ziggo (not :root), so pages/*.json#customProps (root-only) lists only a11y/transition/navigation props; the color/radius/type token layer is read from head.*.css.
Logo: census aggregate.logo.source = "none"; per-page logoCandidates[0] on the home record is img.vfz-navbar__brand-image (scene7 SVG). Logo file not downloaded (localPath null).
Favicon: none captured (no link rel=icon in the DOM, /favicon.ico unreachable per _crawl-log.json#favicon = null).
Home-only vs cross-page: home radii mode is 16px/8px (110 each, mediabox tiles + thumbnails); cross-page mode is 24px (705 occurrences, cards/tiles/sub-nav). Cross-page value preferred.
Home hero headline is not a heading element; page h1 on home is "Daarom kies je Ziggo" rendered in Vodafone Ziggo text 25px/300.
Third-party widgets excluded from components/voice: Dimelo chat pre-form (aside.dimelo-form, open in every capture), feedback survey widget (#surveyContent "Suggesties?"), OneTrust consent.
Diodrum (45 computed buttons) has no @font-face and no file; it is a third-party (OneTrust/feedback widget) declaration — recorded in type.unresolvedFamilies, no file invented.
